evidence: Both the canopy top (rows 9-12, front edge highlight at row 12, eave shadow at rows 13-14) and the bench seat (rows 37-40 with red cushions and front edge highlight at row 40, overhang shadow at row 41, base rows 41-46) show clear 4-row horizontal top bands.
